notes: Valumonics L2: additive-only bans on top of the L1 baseline. Two families — (a) agency/startup hype that contradicts the sober independent-adviser register, (b) outcome guarantees, which a regulated advisory firm must never make. The no-exclamation-marks and usted-register rules are prose rules in voice-profile.md rather than substring bans, because a blunt '!' substring would also fire inside code, URLs and quoted source material.
